title: Llamafile Builder Models Registry
description: Schema for models.json - defines available models and their downloadable files

config_version.description: Schema version number. Incremented when the format changes.

min_builder_version.description: Minimum builder version required to use this config (semver, e.g. '0.1.0')

Model.description: A model available for building into a llamafile

id.description: Unique identifier for the model. For HF sources, this is the repo ID (e.g. 'Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B-GGUF').

source.description: Where this model's files come from. Currently only 'hf' (Hugging Face) is supported.

organization.description: Organization or author that created the model

parameters.description: Model size as a human-readable string (e.g., '7B', '0.6B', '20B')

param_count.description: Exact parameter count as a number (e.g., 7000000000 for 7B)

description.description: Brief description of the model's capabilities

license.description: License under which the model is released (e.g., 'Apache 2.0', 'MIT')

huggingface_url.description: URL to the model's Hugging Face page

tags.description: Capability tags for filtering and display

context_length.description: Default context length for this model

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the upstream repository was created (informational only).

default.description: If true, this model is selected by default when no model is specified

files.description: Downloadable files for this model (weights, vision adapters, etc.)

ModelFile.description: A downloadable file within a model

role.description: 'weights' for main model weights, 'mmproj' for multimodal vision adapter

label.description: Human-readable label for display (e.g., 'Model Weights', 'Vision Adapter')

quantizations.description: Available quantization variants of this file

Quantization.description: A specific quantized version of a model file

name.description: Quantization name. Restricted to the set llamafile-builder understands; the hf-crawl tool emits the same allowlist.

filename.description: Basename of the file inside the source repository (e.g. 'model-Q4_K_M.gguf'). For HF sources, hf-hub resolves this against the repo ID.

download_url.description: Optional override for the download URL. When omitted, the URL is constructed from the model's source + id + filename. Used when a quantization lives in a different repo than the rest of the model.

sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the file for integrity verification
